name: Tria Card
summary: Self-custodial Visa from Tria that spends from 1,000+ tokens, with cashback from 1.5% to 6% depending on your membership.

cashback.note: Lite: 1.5% on the first $1,000 a month, then 0.5%. Pro: 4.5% on the first $1,000, then 1%. Max: 6% on the first $2,000, then 1%.

fees.fxNote: Billed in US dollars. Tria charges no FX fee of its own; its help center says fees vary by region and card type, and the card terms allow Visa FX of up to 3%.
fees.atm: Pro and Max: up to $750 a day, fee not published. No ATM access on Lite.

perks: 6% with no cap on Tria Travel (hotels, rentals; not flights)
Visa Luxury Hotels and Visa concierge

pros: No FX or deposit fees on any tier
